outcome: Rate of vaginal delivery within 24 hours
Time from first intervention to delivery
cohort: 287 women aged 18 years or older with singleton, cephalic pregnancies of 36(6/7) to 42(0/7) weeks' gestation undergoing labor induction at a single urban, tertiary, academic medical center
finding: Concordance with a proposed labor induction algorithm was associated with an increased rate of vaginal delivery within 24 hours, shorter time from first intervention to delivery, and reduced cesarean delivery rate.
